Куркумин.about: Turmeric polyphenol: inflammation (NF-κB); bioavailability itself is poor.
Куркумин.caution: The bioavailability of curcumin is VERY low without enhancers (piperine, liposomes, nanoparticles). Cochrane: Works to maintain remission in ulcerative colitis. For OA: moderate effect. For weight loss/cancer: data are weak. Caution: cholelithiasis, anticoagulants.
Куркумин.food_sources: Turmeric in food (about 3% curcumin); with piperine and fats the absorption is higher.
Куркумин.guidelines: EFSA: claims not approved; a number of MAs have a modest effect in osteoarthritis (small trials, heterogeneity).
Куркумин.how_to_choose: Standardization of 95% curcuminoids + piperine or phosphosome/liquid forms; “turmeric powder in capsule” is weak.

interactions.note: enhances the effect, risk of bleeding

mechs: Inhibition of NF-κB, increase in BDNF; bioavailability is low (requires piperine)
Anti-inflammatory effect in GI: maintaining remission of ulcerative colitis
No relapses in combination with mesalazine
Metabolic effect in type 2 diabetes mellitus (body composition)
Body weight, BMI and waist circumference are lower (>1000 mg/day)
Куркумин.myths: “Turmeric in food = supplement dose” - 1-2 g of powder contains 30-60 mg of curcumin with poor absorption. “Completely cures inflammation”—the effect is modest.
Куркумин.name: Curcumin
Куркумин.onset: Joint pain - 4-8 weeks; there is no immediate effect.
Куркумин.title: Curcumin
Куркумин.upper_limit: There is no formal UL; high doses - GI discomfort; for gallstones - carefully (choleretic).
Куркумин.who_needs: Osteoarthritis as a supplement; components of metabolic syndrome (moderate data).
